rootCause.summary: Generic brand extraction is pilot-keyed. resolveBrandExtractionContext only resolves PILOT_BRANDS; Tribute is not a pilot, so getBrandFieldHints returned null for every field and the extractor emitted registry-wide data-gap placeholders.
evidence: brand-extraction-context.js: resolveBrandExtractionContext → { resolved:false, pilotKey:null } for non-pilot brandId.
brand-field-extraction-hints.js: getBrandFieldHints returns null when !pilotKey; BRAND_HINT_PROFILES only has kimptonHotels + curioCollection.
brand-extract-rules.js: extractBrandFactsFromText pushes gapFact when tryExtractField returns null → all 24 fields became gaps.
notTheCause: Source text loading works: FDD ~1.3M chars, Bonvoy 13.5k, consumer 2.8k, brand page 3.6k, dev captures 3–6k.
Source roles / extraction eligibility fine: 6/6 approved for Explorer + Extraction.
Fact steward is correctly strict: it refused to approve gap/placeholder facts (protected governance).
